paragraphs: Rabbi Adda of Caesarea. Rabbi Adda the elder of Caesarea recited before Rabbi Yochanan (Mo'ed Katan 20b lacks “elder”). He is Rav Adda bar Avuya, before Rabbi Yochanan (I did not find mention of him). Jerusalem Talmud, end of chapter 4 and end of Rosh Hashanah: Rabbi Adda of Caesarea in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. (See above, Abba of Caesarea; perhaps one is an error.)
